0.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_000
0.description: Always a pleasure, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. I'm sure you're eager to get to it, but before we begin, I want to make sure you remember where we left off.

1.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_001
1.description: To review, we established a base camp here so we could make use of a proto-aetheryte nearby. This aetheryte was constructed several thousand years ago, and is a precursor to the designs we use today. As such, we used it primarily for monitoring aetherial fluctuations, and rarely for teleportation.

2.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_002
2.description: Per Ejika's suggestion, we've decided to study this proto-aetheryte that we might gain greater insight into the many mysteries surrounding the Isle of Val and its current state. If, in doing so, we can further stabilize the regional Aethernet, then all the better.

3.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_003
3.description: Our primary objective, as ever, remains the same: find a way to reach the headquarters of the Students of Baldesion at the isle's center, and there seek out and aid any survivors.

4.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_004
4.description: And that about covers it. Did you see Ejika on your way in, by the way? He should have arrived by now...

5.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_005
5.description: Speak of the devil...<hex:02100103>Ejika! Surely you saw us standing over here? Don't be a stranger─come and speak with us!

6.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_EJIKATSUNJIKA_000_006
6.description: ...Oh, you two. Forgive me, I was lost in thought.

7.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_007
7.description: Hmm... I've never known you to be that oblivious as to your surroundings. What troubles you, Ejika?

8.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_EJIKATSUNJIKA_000_008
8.description: Well, I... You know, this place and... Ahem. It is of no moment. Would that I had new information to share, but alas, I do not.

9.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_EJIKATSUNJIKA_000_009
9.description: I can but hope that I can be of greater use to you all in the future. Best of luck to you both in your many endeavors.

10.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_010
10.description: Gods, he's a terrible liar. Nevertheless, I know better than to pester him for answers when he's behaving like that. It's the same as when he's wrestling with his research.

11.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_011
11.description: He'll talk when he's good and ready─which will hopefully be sooner than later. Or maybe he'll be more forthcoming if and when you run into him in the wild, like before? Maybe try asking him then.

12.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_012
12.description: But enough about Ejika. You should see the proto-aetheryte for yourself. It's not far from here. If you'll come with me...

13.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_020
13.description: ...As for the results of my tests...well, while I've yet to grasp the whole picture, my general understanding of the aetherial instability we've been dealing with is much improved.

14.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_021
14.description: Curiously, this is not as recent a development as I had believed. In fact, according to records I found in the foundry, a massive and sustained increase in aetherial density in the vicinity of our headquarters was first recorded almost twenty years ago...

16.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_A1_000_001
16.description: Do you think this was Galuf's doing?

17.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_A1_000_002
17.description: You don't think this was a natural increase, do you?

18.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_030
18.description: It's certainly possible. Whatever he intended to accomplish by “reversing the flow” could have entailed the manipulation of aetherial currents that they might converge upon our headquarters.

19.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_040
19.description: Not in the least. In your vision of the past, Grandfather spoke of “reversing the flow,” which could have entailed the manipulation of aetherial currents that they might converge upon our headquarters.

20.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_050
20.description: To what end is perhaps the more important question...especially since my initial survey suggests that a deiform entity is located somewhere beneath the headquarters of the Students of Baldesion.

21.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_051
21.description: To make matters worse, it seems this entity is growing in strength, perhaps by feeding off the aether being funneled towards the center of the isle...

22.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_052
22.description: I doubt this was Grandfather and the others' intention at the time, of course. Rather, given what you saw in your visions, it is far more likely that they were attempting to imprison a primal being.

23.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_053
23.description: Unfortunately, if these results are any indication, whatever measures they took to do so are failing, and this entity may soon break free.

24.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_054
24.description: Perhaps it was in response to this mounting danger that someone erected a barrier around our headquarters. A final desperate measure to contain a terrible threat...

25.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_055
25.description: Only time and further study will tell. Anyway, to my mind, we still have two primary objectives at present.

26.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_056
26.description: First, we use every method at our disposal to ascertain the nature of the primal and the methods Grandfather and the others employed to hold it in check.

27.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_057
27.description: Second─and as before─we continue to work towards restoring the regional Aethernet to full functionality in order to gain access to headquarters and search for survivors.

28.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_058
28.description: At first I thought that Grandfather might need our help, but perhaps it is us who need his help─especially if we're dealing with primals or Ascians or gods know what else.

29.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_059
29.description: But we'll cross that bridge when we come to it. For now, we have more simple concerns. I've located another confluence of aether not far from here, suggesting the presence of magicite.

30.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_060
30.description: It's somewhere in the northeastern Ice Needles. I'd like you to go and investigate it, if that's all right.

31.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_061
31.description: Thank you. I'll spare you the warnings about the untold dangers lurking out there, given that this is hardly your first time here in Eureka. Good luck.

32.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_070
32.description: The confluence is somewhere in the northeastern Ice Needles. I'm afraid I can't narrow it down further.

33.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_080
33.description: You found it, I presume? The confluence vanished while you were away, so call it a hunch. Since your magia board can hold no more magicite, I hope you'll allow me to hold on to this piece for the time being.

34.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_081
34.description: Much appreciated. There are other confluences elsewhere in Pyros, so I expect I'll be asking you to do this again as soon as we've pinpointed their locations.

35.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_SYSTEM_000_082
35.description: You may continue the Eureka expedition upon reaching elemental level 38.

36.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_090
36.description: It is my hope that this magicite you found might prove useful in my work with the proto-aetheryte. There's still an awful lot I don't know about what Grandfather and the others were up to...

37.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_091
37.description: Until I have more information to share, I'm afraid you'll just have to wait.

38.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_SYSTEM_000_092
38.description: You may continue the Eureka expedition upon reaching elemental level 38.

39.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_100
39.description: Oh, I was just thinking of sending someone to find you. I have tidings.

40.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_101
40.description: Believe it or not, that magicite you found was key to confirming beyond a shadow of a doubt what I had long suspected: that the Isle of Val came to the Glass Ocean by way of a powerful teleportation magick.

41.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_102
41.description: In other words, the theories we had about the Ascians or whoever else unleashing a destructive magick akin to Ultima were completely mistaken.

42.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_103
42.description: Which isn't to say that this teleportation magick wasn't exceedingly destructive and disruptive in its own right. An island does not up and vanish and reappear on the other side of the world without significant repercussions.

43.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_104
43.description: All the strange phenomena we've observed until now─the twisted aetherial currents, the warped elemental energies and erratic weather, magicite and logograms and monsters─all of it stems from this teleportation.

44.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_105
44.description: All of this could have been anticipated, at least to a degree, which prompts me to wonder why someone would nevertheless decide to utilize such a powerful magick. The answer to that question, however, continues to elude me...

45.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_106
45.description: No point dwelling on it. We have another confluence to investigate─or will, as soon as I finish analyzing this data. There is another matter you might attend to before then, though.

46.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_107
46.description: It concerns the logos manipulator, and certain improvements that should make your life a lot easier. Drake can tell you more.

47.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_110
47.description: ...On the other hand, I suppose it's possible that a hostile entity did bring Ultima or some other magick to bear against the isle, and in response someone else triggered the teleportation magick in order to escape...

48.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_112
48.description: Sorry, just thinking aloud. And still trying to locate that confluence for you. Why not talk to Drake about that task of his while I work?

49.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_120
49.description: You've finished helping Drake improve the logos manipulator? Well done. It ought to prove more useful than ever.

50.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_121
50.description: Now then, as you've probably guessed, I've finally located the next piece of magicite I'd like you to go and collect.

51.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_123
51.description: This one you'll find in the caves to the northeast, near a place called the Firing Chamber. Getting there won't be easy, I'm afraid. Be careful.

52.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_130
52.description: To get to the Firing Chamber, you'll need to head due east from here, towards the northeastern Ice Needles. Look for a tunnel in the rock, and follow it north into the caves.

53.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_140
53.description: It's always a relief to see you return safe and sound. Did you find the magicite near the Firing Chamber?

54.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_141
54.description: But of course. Though...I take it there's something else you wish to share?

55.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_142
55.description: So according to Ejika, the deiform entity is also named Eureka, is it...?

56.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_143
56.description: I am reminded of a conversation I once overheard, back before I left the Isle of Val. Raha, one of my colleagues, was discussing a theory he had concerning the Crystal Tower with Grandfather and the other founders.

57.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_144
57.description: As you may recall, Eureka was the name of an underground labyrinth said to contain the most powerful weapons of the Allagan Empire. At least, that's how the legend goes─and Raha thought it might be beneath the Crystal Tower.

58.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_145
58.description: I remember thinking at the time it was odd how the founders suddenly grew quiet and stone-faced, how Grandfather simply said no and ushered the others away, leaving Raha to wonder if he had somehow given offense.

59.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_146
59.description: And then I had to go and pick the same silly name when prompted by Rowena. Ugh. Don't read too much into that. Seriously.

60.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_147
60.description: Anyway, I can only presume that the founder's behavior that day was because, for them, the word Eureka had an entirely different meaning. Even though Raha was clearly talking about the labyrinth, their secret knowledge of the primal clearly weighed heavy on their consciences...

61.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_148
61.description: You've given me much to think about, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>...

62.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_SYSTEM_000_149
62.description: You may continue the Eureka expedition upon reaching elemental level 40.

63.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_150
63.description: That reminds me─you spent a good deal of time with Raha too, didn't you? I read the NOAH reports, so you know.

64.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_151
64.description: He was always so vibrant, so full of life. So dedicated to his work...to his quest for personal meaning. I'd like to think he found it, thanks to you.

65.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_152
65.description: Oh, look at me, waxing nostalgic. He'd laugh if he could see me now! Let us not dwell on the past, but look to the future─to the challenges ahead. I don't know what Eureka is, or if it still poses a threat, but regardless, we'll deal with it when the time comes!

66.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_160
66.description: I don't know what Eureka is, or if it still poses a threat, but regardless, we'll deal with it when the time comes!

67.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_SYSTEM_000_170
67.description: You may continue the Eureka expedition upon reaching elemental level 40.

68.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_180
68.description: I know this is sudden, but I have to ask: you didn't stumble across a piece of magicite recently, did you?

69.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_181
69.description: I was afraid you might say no. You see, I've been tracking a number of confluences, but before I could pinpoint their exact location, each vanished without a trace. Which isn't necessarily a bad thing, given that the aetherial currents have become more stable as a result, but...

70.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_182
70.description: ...But I cannot believe this is a natural occurrence. Magicite doesn't simply vanish on its own, which leads me to believe someone is collecting it. If not you, then that leaves...Ejika?

71.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_183
71.description: But even if he is trying to help, he could at least let us know. And if he's not doing it for us, then that leads me to wonder why. Until we meet again, though, we can only carry on with our original plans.

72.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_184
72.description: There's one confluence I've located in West Flamerock that has yet to dissipate. If you would be so kind as to hasten to it and retrieve it, I would be most grateful.

73.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_190
73.description: If you happen to run into Ejika in West Flamerock, perhaps you can ask him what he's up to. If not, then at least we'll have one more piece of magicite and the aetherial currents will be that much better.

74.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_200
74.description: Welcome back. I take it you have a magicite for me?

75.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_201
75.description: And Ejika was nowhere to be found, was he? Not that I expected us to get that lucky again. As for me and my research, I think I am getting closer and closer to understanding Grandfather's intent in “reversing” the flow...

76.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_202
76.description: You'll forgive me if I refrain from divulging my theories until I am more confident, though. I wouldn't want to look the fool!

77.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_SYSTEM_000_203
77.description: You may continue the Eureka expedition upon reaching elemental level 45.

78.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_210
78.description: Soon, my friend, soon I hope to understand what Grandfather and the others were trying to accomplish. I need but a little more time...

79.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_SYSTEM_000_211
79.description: You may continue the Eureka expedition upon reaching elemental level 45.

80.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_500
80.description: It's so simple, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! How could I have not seen it earlier!?

81.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_501
81.description: It's a massive ward─one which encompasses the whole of the isle! By diverting the aetherial currents as they did, Grandfather and the others transformed the Isle of Val into an arcane ward!

82.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_502
82.description: But that was only in the beginning, for what Grandfather later realized was that, by inverting the pattern and reversing the aetherial flow, the primal could be slowly drained of aether, eventually killing it once and for all!

83.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_503
83.description: Oh, how to explain... Ah! It's like your magia board. Yes─imagine the entire Isle of Val is one giant magia board. Not exactly, of course, but close enough.

84.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_504
84.description: Every confluence marks a blockage in the aetherial flow, reducing the effectiveness of the board. But, with every blockage removed, the effectiveness increases, and the ward holding the primal in place grows stronger...

85.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_505
85.description: On second thought, that's not at all similar to the magia board, but never mind that! The important thing is that removing the blockages is key to strengthening the ward─and to that end, we've made great strides.

86.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_506
86.description: But as it was with Pagos and Anemos before, we cannot simply clear the smaller blockages and call it a day. To completely restore the flow within a given region, we need to, in essence, align certain key points.

87.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_507
87.description: Were I to return to my rather poor metaphor of a magia board, these would be analogous to pieces of magicite, perhaps...

88.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_508
88.description: Naturally, given the scale of the ward in question, these would need to be far larger than the pieces in our possession. For a region the size of Pyros, we would need at least four...four what...?

93.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_511
93.description: Giant spinning what-now? Are you struggling to describe an aetheryte?

94.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_512
94.description: By the Twelve, for whatever inexplicable reason I simply cannot help but miss the most obvious solution. I wonder if this is why the founders were so devoted to the study of aetheryte technologies? All the while they were constructing an Aethernet that served a second secret purpose...

95.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_513
95.description: I'm glad you're here to show me the light, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>...

96.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_514
96.description: Gods, for a moment I thought that was an earthquake...

97.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_515
97.description: I sense a disturbance in the aether. But this doesn't make any... Oh no! We have to go to the proto-aetheryte right now!

98.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_516
98.description: No, no, no─this is all wrong! It was working perfectly fine before! How could this have happened!?

101.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_EJIKATSUNJIKA_000_519
101.description: I have removed a rather vexing impediment from the equation. The proto-aetheryte was integral to the ward.

102.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_520
102.description: You knew, and yet you...you... Help me to understand, Ejika.

103.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_EJIKATSUNJIKA_000_521
103.description: As if either of you ever could. No, I think I'll let him do the talking.

104.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_EUREKAPERSON_000_522
104.description: Breaker of chains, thou hast kept the faith. The covenant is forged. Bearer just and true, hand worthy to wield the blade...

105.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_EJIKATSUNJIKA_000_523
105.description: And what a magnificent blade it is. Pure aether, by my reckoning. Perhaps the finest blade ever forged. All that I wanted and more...

106.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_EJIKATSUNJIKA_000_524
106.description: Such strength is now mine to command. To use as I see fit. Is this the power that sets your heart racing, O brave and beloved adventurer? When you hold your enemy's life in your hands?

107.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_525
107.description: This isn't you, Ejika! Don't you see? The primal is clouding your mind!

108.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_EJIKATSUNJIKA_000_526
108.description: Oh, dearest Krile. You could not be more wrong. I see it all so clearly now. With open eyes have I welcomed this power into my being─welcomed the glory of Eureka into my heart.

109.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_EUREKAPERSON_000_527
109.description: (-Eureka-)In light <hex:02080CE905FF04736865FF03686503> walketh...and in light <hex:02080CE905FF04736865FF03686503> abideth. As did the one before who tried and failed to lay us low. But now we have a champion...

110.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_528
110.description: Oh, Ejika... Don't do this. Don't let it make you its thrall.

111.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_EJIKATSUNJIKA_000_529
111.description: ...I am, and ever will be, my own master, Krile.<hex:02100103>I will wait for you within the tower, at its prison. But be warned─I will not wait forever...

113.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_531
113.description: I...I don't know what to do...

114.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_532
114.description: I don't know what to do. Even after reinforcing the frame, it's not enough to stabilize the internal components. At this rate, we'll never get it up and running again.

115.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_533
115.description: If we were in the Sharlayan motherland, perhaps, I'd have all the necessary equipment at my disposal. But it's on the other side of the world...

116.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_534
116.description: Not only did Ejika destabilize the regional aethernet, I fear he may have shattered the ward Grandfather and the others put in place.

117.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_535
117.description: If so, then there is nothing stopping Eureka from feeding upon the aetherial currents. Eventually, it'll be strong enough to shatter the barrier encompassing our headquarters, and once that happens, it's all over.

118.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_536
118.description: ...He's succumbed to the primal's influence, hasn't he?

119.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_537
119.description: I don't want to believe it, but after everything he said and did...

120.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_538
120.description: How did we come to this? Just when it felt like we were so, so close to setting things right. <sigh> If ever there was a time I wished Grandfather were here to offer his advice...

121.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_550
121.description: Gods, I can barely keep my eyes open. If I have to spend another night slaving away for the sake of aetherological experiments...

122.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_EJIKATSUNJIKA_000_551
122.description: For someone so exhausted, you clearly have enough energy to whine.

123.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_552
123.description: As if it's not taking its toll on you too. I can see it in your face, and hear it in your increasingly curt instructions.

124.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_EJIKATSUNJIKA_000_553
124.description: What you call curt, I call efficient. If you're so concerned about whiling away the hours, you could spare me the idle chitchat and leave me to my work. Not all of us can coast on reputation and gods-given blessings.

125.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_554
125.description: <sigh> Ejika, I'm not looking for another fight. I'm here to help.

126.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_EJIKATSUNJIKA_000_555
126.description: You can help by being anywhere but here. I have matters well in hand and do not require your assistance whatsoever.

127.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_556
127.description: Oh, you mean now that we've solved those thorny problems which drove you to come to me in the first place? Why am I not surprised that, once again, you're pushing me away the moment you no longer have need of me? Ugh, I knew this was going to happen...

128.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_EJIKATSUNJIKA_000_556
128.description: Did you now? Then why did you come here?

129.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_557
129.description: By the Twelve, Ejika, I don't hate you! I've never hated you! You're exhausting and annoying and rude and a bloody pain to work with...

130.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_558
130.description: But you're also driven and clever and, gods help me, I actually enjoy your company! And I think your research has merit, and I want to see you succeed! Is that really so hard to believe?

131.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_EJIKATSUNJIKA_000_559
131.description: ...If you're going to stay, then you should at least make yourself useful.

132.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_GALUFBALDESION_000_560
132.description: Oh Krile, Ejika. You two truly do make a wonderful pair.

134.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_610
134.description: I'm sorry, but I'm still trying to get my bearings. After everything that's happened, we need to take our time to formulate a plan of action.

135.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_SYSTEM_000_611
135.description: You may continue the Eureka expedition upon reaching elemental level 50.

136.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_620
136.description: Let's take stock of what we know. A deiform entity named Eureka was imprisoned within the central tower of the headquarters of the Students of Baldesion by means of a complex arcane ward spanning the entirety of the Isle of Val.

137.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_621
137.description: Said ward was then modified by Grandfather and the other founders to slowly drain Eureka of its considerable aether, eventually killing it once and for all. However, with the proto-aetheryte no longer operational, the ward has been broken, perhaps permanently.

138.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_622
138.description: Without the ward to bind or drain it of aether, Eureka can feed on the aetherial currents to regain its strength and eventually break free of the barrier surrounding our headquarters.

139.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_623
139.description: Assuming Eureka dates back to the time of Allag, defeating it in the traditional manner would ensure it never returned, as those who summoned it forth are long dead. Yet Grandfather and the others instead elected to imprison it here on the isle. The question is, why?

140.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_624
140.description: If, for some reason, slaying it is not an option, then we would need to restore the original ward. Alas, without the proto-aetheryte, I cannot see a means to do so. Simply put, we have no good options.

141.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_625
141.description: That said, we cannot simply throw our hands up and do nothing, can we? I should like to think we are of one mind in that respect.

142.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_626
142.description: So! In the spirit of trying something, anything, regardless of how ineffectual it may prove, I would like you to first help me tie up a loose end.

143.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_627
143.description: I've detected another confluence in East Flamerock. The last piece of magicite still clogging the aetherial arteries of Pyros, I suspect. I'd like you to go and collect it for me. Please.

144.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_630
144.description: The confluence is somewhere in East Flamerock. I'm afraid I can't narrow it down more than that. Still, it's hardly the first time you've had to scour a large-ish area crawling with slavering fiends, is it?

145.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_640
145.description: Good, you've returned. I hope your trip was uneventful?

146.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_641
146.description: And with that, we have the final magicite of Pyros! Thank you so much for this and everything else you have done for me.

147.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_642
147.description: I've been thinking, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. If the ward is the best means by which we might contain and defeat Eureka, then we must restore it─and we must do so without the proto-aetheryte we cannot repair.

148.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_643
148.description: And so I propose to you: what if we were to instead construct a new focal point to replace the void left by the proto-aetheryte?

149.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_644
149.description: I'm quite serious. If we were to utilize the magicite we have collected thus far, I believe we could construct a facsimile to serve in the aetheryte's place.

150.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_645
150.description: I won't lie. Doing this will take significant time and resources─materials and manpower─that we lack at present. Even so, I think this is our best option.

151.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_646
151.description: To achieve this, we'll also need to redirect the aetherial streams to fuel the process. To immerse the magicite in a torrential flood of aether, namely the endless font rising from Pagos.

152.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_647
152.description: Whether or not this is even possible is another question altogether. Therefore, I'd like you to perform a simple test for me.

153.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_648
153.description: The magicite I've given you has been specially treated to facilitate the absorption of aether. I want you to take it to the Cavern of the Second Cant, which is directly above the Fumarole of Pagos.

154.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_649
154.description: Hold it above the aetherial font and observe how it reacts, then return to me and report your findings. Thank you!

155.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_650
155.description: The aetherial font rising from the Fumarole should extend all the way to the Cavern of the Second Cant. Take the treated magicite there and observe how it reacts, then return to me with your findings.

156.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_660
156.description: Please tell me you come bearing good news...

157.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_661
157.description: What a relief! Then the method I envisioned for constructing an aetheryte facsimile to restore the ward should be viable.

158.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_662
158.description: And with that, I believe we have once again come to the end of our time together. As I mentioned before, this process will require significant time and resources which we lack at present, so there's nothing else you can contribute to our expedition for now.

159.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_663
159.description: I should say, though, that the next stage of our expedition may well be our last. If we can't gain access to our headquarters soon, then we may be too late to stop Eureka, and then...

160.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_664
160.description: Bah. I'll refrain from grim predictions and the like, especially when I should like to think it will not come to that. We're coming for you, Ejika!

161.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_SYSTEM_000_665
161.description: You have reached the conclusion of this chapter of the Eureka expedition. The expedition will continue in a future update.

162.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_SYSTEM_100_665
162.description: You have reached the conclusion of this chapter of the Eureka expedition.

163.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_SYSTEM_150_665
163.description: To continue the expedition, speak with Rodney at Pier #1 in Kugane to travel to <hex:02281CFF17436F6E74656E7446696E646572436F6E646974696F6EE8022C03>.

164.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_SYSTEM_000_666
164.description: You may now ride mounts within Eureka Pyros!

165.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_KRILE_000_670
165.description: Not that I don't enjoy your company, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, but there's really nothing else you can do to help us at this time. I'll let you know when we're ready to continue with the expedition.

166.name: TEXT_CTSERKEUREKA3KRILE1_00512_SYSTEM_000_671
166.description: You have reached the conclusion of this chapter of the Eureka expedition. The expedition will continue in a future update.
